load_meteor_metric: load the METEOR evaluation metric module using evaluate.load("meteor")
launch_gradio_widget: launch an interactive Gradio widget for the METEOR metric evaluation
run_meteor_evaluate: run the METEOR metric to evaluate translation quality between predictions and references
build_meteor_gradio_app: build a Gradio app that provides an interactive UI for METEOR metric evaluation
test_meteor_metric: test the METEOR metric by loading it with evaluate.load and computing scores
